desc: The Multiplayer pages left with B on a controller (Aurora, no window), from the title's page (TTYD_OPEN_MULTIPLAYER): Online... opened, its code keyboard (Join by code) opened, B until the keyboard is gone (B rubs out what is typed, then leaves), B from Online... to the front list, B to the tabs and B again closes the pages (the title's buttons). Each B must leave the page it is on ('[online] page:' says where it went)
log_must: ^\[title\] the pages closed: back to the title's buttons
